artifact: Signed head statement (the target form, WP-7.1)
authority: 6-contracts/6-contract-ledger-notp.md#refs-and-head-statement; crates/permguard-objects/src/statement.rs (KEY_ZONE to KEY_KEY_SET, COSE_HEADER_ALG, COSE_HEADER_CONTENT_TYPE, COSE_HEADER_KID, CONTENT_TYPE)
encoding: deterministic CBOR (RFC 8949 core deterministic), integers in the signed 64-bit range

fields.name: alg
fields.note: the COSE algorithm of the signing ring's suite: -8 EdDSA, -7 ES256

fields.name: kid
fields.note: the UTF-8 bytes of the signing key's id

fields.name: authority_host_id
fields.note: 16 bytes: the host_id of the Control Plane Host that signs

fields.name: ref_digest
fields.note: the digest of the ref state, notp.json ref_state

fields.name: key_set_digest
fields.note: the digest of the signing ring's key set

cose_sign1.name: signature
cose_sign1.note: the suite's signature over the RFC 9052 Sig_structure ["Signature1", protected, h'', payload]
